misconceptions.description: Treating crowd size or foot traffic as the goal of a prototype showcase
misconceptions.trigger: logistics optimize for milling visitors rather than evidence exchange
misconceptions.feedback: Define the goal as visitors seeing theory-to-screen reasoning and presenters getting substantive questions, then design for that.

misconceptions.description: Running an open house with no prompt that surfaces the README traceability matrix
misconceptions.trigger: stations have no card or question directing visitors to the design reasoning
misconceptions.feedback: Post a focusing prompt per station so the traceability matrix becomes the conversation, not an afterthought.

misconceptions.description: Letting all visitors start together so popular stations crowd and others sit idle
misconceptions.trigger: no rotation or staggered start, so visitor load is uneven across prototypes
misconceptions.feedback: Use timed rotations with staggered start stations so every prototype is seen and no presenter is mobbed.
